data.body: S5 progress: T1 (b81b, change 2235) MERGED + CLOSED CERTIFIED (no force) — completion verifier PASSED after clearing a STALE .tickets-tracker/.git/HEAD.lock (0-byte, 6min old, lsof-confirmed unheld; distinct from the 'ignore contention claims' directive which is about ticket content). Root: a hung enrich_drain worker (PID 74488) held rebar-git-op.lock since 02:25 and left the stale HEAD.lock, blocking tracker writes (consistent with the tickets-push backlog). T1's 6 ACs verified via the AC1-AC6 census oracle (9 passed) mapped per-AC, then ticked (box-tick is attestation-safe). T2 (0f5d, change 2238) ps3 pushed with the CORRECTNESS fix for the LLM-Review -1 blocking finding: recovered was double-counted (mutations_applied folded recovered in via build_pass_tally's legacy applied_count while also surfacing mutations_recovered). Fix un-folds in reconcile only (build_pass_tally's fold is a separately-pinned legacy contract): mutations_applied = max(0, applied - recovered_count) → DISJOINT buckets summing to mutation_count (AC5 exact). RED-first (5==3) then GREEN; regression 4558 passed/2 skipped; reconcile 798 LOC. T2 ps3: CI (Verified) re-running; LLM-Review cast a fail-closed -1 = coverage-gap (llm-unavailable): the review-bot's direct claude-opus-4-8 key returned 401 (infra, not code). Will re-trigger via 'rerun-llm-review' (ADR 0069) once the provider recovers. NB: local bedrock LLM ops are healthy (T1 verifier + review-plan certified).
